name: N1P
description: N1P is the operating system of a one-person business: the business brain (positioning, audience, offers, voice), sales copy and content. Agents read the brain, update one field at a time, save copy and content to the right N1P screens, and post updates the owner sees. Every change keeps the previous text and can be undone in N1P; no tool deletes anything. Each user signs in to their own N1P account through the browser.

prompts.text: Read my N1P brain and tell me which fields are empty or weak.
Rewrite my positioning statement in N1P from what my brain already says.
Write a carousel about my main offer and save it to my N1P content library.

apps.name: N1P
apps.description: Read the N1P business brain, update one field at a time with undo, save sales copy and content, and post updates, over N1P's MCP server with browser sign-in.
